name: Source Snapshot Contract
summary: Defines how source files are hashed, ignored, snapshotted, and compared for newly counted equals.

snapshot.files: object keyed by hashed relative path

auth_rules: Raw source paths and file contents are not stored in the snapshot.
failure_modes: Ignored directories include .git, node_modules, dist, build, .next, out, and coverage.
Binary or files larger than 1 MiB are skipped.
Non-real-code lines are ignored before equals counting.

evidence.reason: Defines ignored dirs, size limits, binary checks, line hashing, equals counting, and snapshot comparison.
Uses source snapshots for registration, refresh, changed path handling, and equals ledger increments.
Asserts baseline, added equals, duplicate lines, deletion, and ignored directory behavior.
